survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.scavenge: You heard the call? I've been picking through this place for days. Get me out of here and I'll share what I find.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.medic: Thank god. I've got bandages and not much else. Take me somewhere safe and I'll patch you up.
survivor.dead_air.line.stranded.radio_op: That was my signal. I kept it going as long as the battery lasted. I can keep a radio alive, if you keep me alive.
survivor.dead_air.line.missing: I got separated… hurt my leg. Lead me home and I'll follow.
survivor.dead_air.line.settled: Quiet here. I like it. Come back in a couple of days.
survivor.dead_air.line.supplies_ready: I put something aside for you.
survivor.dead_air.hope.find_family: I still hope they're out there somewhere.
survivor.dead_air.hope.safe_home: I just want four walls that stay quiet at night.
survivor.dead_air.hope.fix_the_signal: If we can keep the towers up, people can find each other.
survivor.dead_air.hope.see_the_ocean: I used to dream about the coast. Still do.
survivor.dead_air.hope.stock_a_cache: Every spare scrap goes in the cache. One day it'll matter.
survivor.dead_air.hope.quiet_days: No broadcasts. No screaming. Just quiet days.
survivor.dead_air.who.cheerful: I'm %s — a %s. Combat style: %s. Still smiling, somehow.
survivor.dead_air.who.grim: Name's %s. %s. I fight %s. Don't expect pep talks.
survivor.dead_air.who.paranoid: %s. %s. I stay %s for a reason. Trust is expensive.
survivor.dead_air.who.loyal: %s. %s. I'll watch your back — %s if I have to.
survivor.dead_air.who.sarcastic: %s, allegedly a %s. Orientation: %s. Charming, I know.
survivor.dead_air.idle.cheerful.0: %s grins. 'Could be worse. We've got coffee… somewhere.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.cheerful.1: 'You ever notice how quiet feels louder after a broadcast?'
survivor.dead_air.idle.cheerful.2: 'Stick with me and we'll make this place livable.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.cheerful.3: 'Hey — thanks for not leaving me out there.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.grim.0: %s stares past you. 'Another day. Same static.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.grim.1: 'Don't ask how I'm doing. Ask what's left to do.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.grim.2: 'I've buried enough people. Not looking to add you.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.grim.3: 'The towers hum. I listen. That's enough.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.paranoid.0: %s checks the treeline. 'Did you hear that?'
survivor.dead_air.idle.paranoid.1: 'Keep the radio low. They listen when we talk.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.paranoid.2: 'I counted footprints. Too many for just us.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.loyal.1: 'You pulled me out. I don't forget that.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.loyal.2: 'Say the word and I'll hold this ground.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.loyal.3: 'We're a unit now. Feels good to say.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.sarcastic.0: %s smirks. 'Oh good. Another crisis. My favourite.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.sarcastic.1: 'Sure, I'll guard the panel. Peak career moment.'
survivor.dead_air.idle.sarcastic.2: 'If the Listener shows up, I'll politely ask it to leave.'
